text:
alex: Noticed odd duplication in resumed streams after last routing tweak. Two customers reported duplicated partial responses when client resumed within 200-500ms of disconnect.
tom: Seen logs for tenant t-998: client disconnect, reconnect/resume, then we emitted the last chunk again. Looks like KV cache wasn't updated to the new "resume_seq" so runtime replayed.
li: Example traces (redacted):
```
[09:42:01] conn=x1 tenant=t-998 state=active seq=42
[09:42:03] conn=x1 -> TCP CLOSE (network)
[09:42:03] client reconnect resume_token=rt-55 seq=42
[09:42:03] proxy: resume accepted (session_id=s-abc)
[09:42:03] runtime: cache miss for session s-abc -> re-eval chunk seq=42
[09:42:04] runtime: emit chunk seq=42 (duplicate)
```
sam: Is the proxy's resume acceptance based on stale metadata? Could it be that the proxy accepts resume before the KV commit from runtime?
alex: That's my suspicion. Proxy tells client "resumed" and client assumes it's safe to continue; but runtime hasn't reconciled the session state and thus replays last outputs.
tom: Replaying last outputs can lead to confusing UX (duplicate sentences) and worst, some customers reported these duplicates counted toward token usage. Billing counts are sticky.
ui-team: We need the console to show resume health and last_seq per session so support can triage. Also show if resume was "optimistic" vs "confirmed".
li: Proposal: make resume a two-phase handshake. Proxy issues a provisional accept with an idempotency nonce; runtime will send a confirm event when the KV cache is populated. Until confirm arrives, proxy sends a control event to client: {"event":"resume","status":"provisional","nonce":"n-123"}. On confirm, server sends {"event":"resume","status":"confirmed","nonce":"n-123","last_seq":43}. If confirm doesn't arrive within 250ms, proxy should instruct client to backoff and not send new input.
sam: For WS, flow would be JSON frames; for SSE, in-stream event. Example SSE snippets:
```
event: resume
data: {"status":"provisional","nonce":"n-123"}

event: resume
data: {"status":"confirmed","nonce":"n-123","last_seq":43}

```
li: Telemetry: add metrics resume_phase (provisional|confirmed|expired), resume_latency_ms, resume_nonce, and resume_duplicate_detected. Also tag billing_flag (billed_during_provisional=true/false).
ops-bot: Alert: analytics spike for resume_duplicate_detected for t-998 at 09:42 (4 events).
alex: Short-term mitigation: revert the routing tweak that introduced proxy short-circuit acceptance, or flip feature flag to force runtime-confirm. We need a rollout plan that doesn't break cold-start latency.
tom: Could implement optimistic path for low-risk tenants (internal/test), but force strict confirm for anyone hitting duplicate-detection.
ui-team: UX: surface an icon on live sessions: green=confirmed resume, amber=provisional, red=failed resume, with details when clicked. Also show last_seq and last_activity.
li: Backend changes (rough):
- Proxy: emit provisional accept + hold client writes until confirm/timeout
- Runtime: confirm handshake + populate KV atomically before confirm
- Billing: do not bill tokens generated during provisional window unless confirmed
- SDKs: accept provisional state, queue user input until confirmed (or drop with nacks)
jen: QA plan: simulate runtime delay (100-500ms) and ensure client doesn't send duplicate inputs and duplicates aren't billed. Include e2e with JS/Go SDKs.
alex: Action items:
- tom: rollback/flag tweak (if needed) + dashboard annotation (PR)
- li: design two-phase resume handshake + spec + tests (PR)
- sam: billing-side change proposals and telemetry schema (PR)
- ui-team: console mockups for resume state (Figma link in thread)
- QA: e2e test plan and harness (ticket)
Please paste PR/ticket links here. We'll triage priority today and schedule a short sync at 10:00. :hourglass:
